glow.label: The light list that outgrew its shelf
glow.explanation: The out-of-light flow lists every perma-lit grid on the panel into two arrays of 1536 - with no bound. A fully lit arena panel holds 1600 glowing grids: the original collects all 1600, and AddressSanitizer catches the 1537th write - a global-buffer-overflow in the scan itself. What the overflowing write then corrupts depends on the memory layout of the build (for one analysed build: wrong x coordinates, none off the panel); that is not measured here. The correction stops collecting at the bound: 1536, no overflow, and the flow still runs.
